title: What to send for a job application follow up ✍️
description:
If you aren’t following up on your job applications you are significantly reducing the chance for your application to move forward. 5-7 days after you submit simply send out a quick check in. This will reinforce your interest in the role, and also bring your name back up to the hiring manager’s attention if you application got buried in the mass of applicants. #jobapplication #jobapplications #jobapplicationtips
